purpose: 6 m/s 상한에서 라이다만 입력하는 모델의 복구 학습 및 미학습 트랙 일반화 검증

manifest.method: Fresh temporal CNN, reflection augmentation, recovery-oracle DAgger; teacher only during collection.

speed_observations.note: 6 m/s는 상한이며 코너 목표 속도는 더 낮다.

artifact.git_tracking_policy: Track final TorchScript deployment file only; intermediate outputs remain ignored.

limitations.longitudinal_parameters: assumed randomized ranges, not measured vehicle calibration
limitations.previous_mlp_comparison: Previous 133/138 and current 138/138 use different seeds and protocols; not a paired speed/accuracy comparison.

source_sha256_scope: Source hashes at validation time. Subsequent directory-resolution edits do not retrain the model; see migration report.
